drafts.subject: Please confirm receipt of resin - PO 4500012137 line 10 (Barwon Polymers, BP-03754)
drafts.body:
Hi team,

Barwon Polymers has invoiced us $11,154.00 (invoice BP-03754, dated 12 September 2026) for 6 t of PP homopolymer resin against PO 4500012137, line 10. There is no goods receipt recorded against that line.

Could you please check whether this delivery arrived?

- If it did, please post the goods receipt against PO 4500012137 line 10 so AP can release the invoice for payment.
- If it has not arrived, please let us know and AP will query Barwon Polymers.

The buyer on the PO is J. Okafor if you need to check any details. Thanks for your help.

Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
